decision.reason: [ev-c3fa8260181b] says only that the Helm chart now allows `enabled` to be set so cert-manager can be toggled as a dependency. The validators confirm that `enabled` is a new key, absent from the v1.16.0 values and present in v1.17.0 [ev-fdc96eee87bf][ev-717ddb6f40cd]. None of the evidence says what happened before when `enabled` was set (whether it was rejected or ignored), or that `enabled: false` changes how cert-manager's own chart renders. So the proposed exposure (`enabled` equals "false") assumes an effect the evidence never states, and no other exposure condition is supported either. To decide, we need the PR #7350 diff or schema/template evidence showing how `enabled` was handled before and after the change.
